retrieval.rag_summary:
Metecno Ballistic Point Insulation
Fastener (manufactured by ICCONS under the GTIF series and distributed across
the Australian commercial construction market) is a pre-assembled ballistic
drive pin with an integrated 60mm plastic washer head. Engineered for gas or
powder-actuated tools (such as the GTIXF-160C), it enables rapid, drill-free
fastening of 25mm to 100mm rigid insulation panels directly to hard concrete,
masonry, and structural steel substrates in carparks, soffits, and facade
walls.
